page.overview:
Who is Bleena?

Bleena was a male slicer who lived on the planet Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he worked for Lady Valarian's lieutenant Kavas Urdano. Urdano tasked a spacer with recovering Bleena's tool set that was stolen from him by a band of Jawa. Kavas Urdano later used Bleena to slice the bank account of Ind, another lieutenant of Lady Valarian and the main rival of Kavas.

Bleena was a cut non-player character (NPC) in the 2003 video game Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts,

Bleena was intended to be part of the cancelled [https://swglegends.com/forums/showthread.php?55817-*Friday-Feature-Valarian-Themepark-Walkthrough!*Valarian Themepark]. This questline was initially planned to be introduced in the game with the "Publish 23" to replace the original "Valarian Quest Series." Although the old "Valarian Quest Series" was deactivated with the release of Publish 23 on August 31, 2005, the new Themepark was never activated. Several NPCs of the Valarian Theme Park were implemented into the game but Bleena was not known to have appeared on the live servers. Unused game files pertaining to this questline indicated that Bleena was intended to be part of a new quest named "Thrust."
